title: achras elengoides
intro: Achras elengoides, commonly known as the Sapodilla tree, is a tropical evergreen tree native to the American tropics. This plant has been valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it useful in treating various ailments such as fever, diarrhea, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Achras elengoides are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including sapogenins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which have been shown to possess wound-healing, anti-cancer, and anti-diabetic properties. However, more research is needed to confirm the efficacy of Achras elengoides in treating specific health conditions.
